extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Plant types by where they grow — land plants (mango, neem), water plants (lotus, lily), climbers (money plant, grape vine). (2) Edible parts — root (carrot, radish), leaf (spinach, cabbage), seed (pea, gram), fruit (mango, apple). (3) Medicinal plants — tulsi (cough/cold), neem (skin), aloe (burns). Use only with adult guidance. Misconceptions: 'all plants grow on land' (lotus grows in water, money plant climbs), 'we eat only fruits' (carrot is root, spinach is leaf, pea is seed), 'medicinal plants are medicines we take anytime' (use only with adult guidance). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function PlantTypesGame), NOT export default. Export interface PlantTypesGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
